video_title: What Brunson Told RJ After the Game 3 Loss

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The atmosphere at the NBA Finals was electric
quotes.excerpt: The atmosphere was amazing, the energy was great.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: When we are speaking to last night, can you please just set the tone for us, Richard? What was it like? Were you surprised, the atmosphere?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: The atmosphere was amazing, the energy was great.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks fans brought intense energy to the arena
quotes.excerpt: I was going to give credit to the Knicks fans. It was juiced in there.
quotes.quote: I was going to give credit to the Knicks fans. It was juiced in there. It was a lot of the people that you normally see, but there was still juice in the building. So it wasn't this corporate crowd. That crowd was fired up, everybody was excited. We just talked to Jalen Brunson a couple minutes ago, that's why I'm doing interviews, so I apologize to the roadies. Jalen Brunson was just like, we didn't do the things that we needed to do. He felt like they lost the edge a little bit.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs played with extreme physicality to send a message
quotes.excerpt: All of them seem to make a stand in the sand that says, I'm not dealing with your shit.
quotes.quote: Just from the Spurs point of view, do you think it was a concerted thing for them to be overly physical and overly aggressive to send a message to the Knicks? Basically you go from Cornette to Carter Bryant to Stefan Castle to Wembanyama. All of them seem to make a stand in the sand that says, I'm not dealing with your shit. And number two, if you stand in front of me, I'm just going to truck you and then look at you like a little baby.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs are a highly physical team
quotes.excerpt: This Spurs team has been playing against physical guys.
quotes.quote: When we were talking to the Spurs earlier, they said people forget, the Portland team that we played against was a very physical team. Then you look at OKC, a very, very physical team. So this Spurs team has been playing against physical guys. You have Drew Eubanks, Camara, they had physical defenders in Portland. We know what OKC has with Caruso and Cason Wallace. So they are seasoned when it comes to a physical game. The Spurs are now leading with physicality. If you're down 0-2 and you're on the road, if you're not going to be physical, you don't got much of a chance. You better show up with, I'm going to run some people over. Obviously there is a Wembanyama play, there is a Castle play. Even they were talking about Minnesota. Minnesota, even though they were banged up, they're a physical team. You got Anne Edward, you got Jaden McDaniels, you got good defenders. So when you look at their group, they've been.
